The idea

Most teams build AI the expensive way. We make the efficient way the easy way.

Every capability starts general and costly. We descend it — deterministic rules and cheap models first, the frontier model reserved for supervising the cheaper ones — until it runs at the cheapest cost that still clears the quality bar. You write the goal; the system does the descent.

Proof, in dollars

A land-lease extraction task (12 fields).

Most companies send the entire PDF/email to a frontier model (Gemini-class) to pull out agency, principal, and contract fields. The appropriate way: OCR + patterns answer most fields before any LLM; the LLM only supervises.
